integrity: Analytic demonstration and standalone finite checks; no independent audit claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact one-way-coupled exogenous force driver only; known L, D, v; inversion identifies force powers not phases and assumes exact sampling; unbounded spectrum inversion is potentially ill-conditioned; does not establish the interacting-pair analogue.
title: Exact finite-rate spectroscopy of Fourier force power in a telegraph-driven tracer
